messages:
alex.partnerships: Quick sync — KeyVaultCo wants us to finalize KMS/HSM integration + SCIM provisioning before their marketplace listing. Can we put together a concise tech checklist and announce timeline? They suggested ~2 weeks for joint announcement.

joanne.pm: 2 weeks is tight but maybe doable if eng gets quick access to test creds. I'll need logo + co-marketing blurb from them. Who owns announcement copy?

ryan.platform: From runtime side we'll need a PKCS#11 adapter for HSM, AWS KMS client for envelope fallback, and an envelope encryption flow. Questions: does KeyVaultCo support PKCS#11 v2.40? Also need test keys and an endpoint for staging.

mira.eng: SCIM note: KeyVaultCo said they support SCIM v2.0 with bulk provisioning. We'll need attribute mappings for role -> Redwood RBAC. Basic endpoints: /scim/Users and /scim/Groups. Prototype in staging should respond 200/201.

sam.sec: Compliance checklist: we need FIPS 140-2/3 attestation for HSM, SOC2 report, and details on key export (partner said keys are non-exportable). Also confirm rotation policy and KMS audit logs availability.

alex.partnerships: @joanne.pm can you coordinate comms? @mira.eng @ryan.platform can you both give effort estimates so I can set expectations with KeyVaultCo? I'll ask them for the compliance docs and a short marketing blurb.

joanne.pm: I'll draft announcement + webinar outline. Need a 1-paragraph partner quote and a logo SVG. Target: draft by next Wed.

mira.eng: Rough ETA: basic SCIM provisioning + one-way sync (create/update users) in ~1 week with staging keys. Full role/group mapping + tests ~3 weeks (2 sprints). We'll need sample SCIM attribute map from partner: which attribute holds "team" or "role".

ryan.platform: Runtime ETA: PKCS#11 adapter + unit tests ~1 week. End-to-end with envelope encryption + fallback to AWS KMS + e2e tests ~2 weeks. Need partner to provide PKCS#11 library path or container build.

sam.sec: Action items for partner: send FIPS/SOC2 docs, confirm non-exportable key policy, provide rotation cadence (they proposed 30 days), and provide SIEM/audit webhook docs.

alex.partnerships: I'll ping them now for the docs + a one-liner for marketing. Also propose a joint webinar + PR the week after announcement.

joanne.pm: Can we include default Okta/Azure AD SCIM connector templates? That would make adoption easier for customers.

mira.eng: Yes — we'll add Okta template + Azure AD manifest. Also adding custom attribute 'redwood:teams' for group->team mapping.

ryan.platform: Quick sample config for customers (staging example):

```yaml
redwood:
  kms:
    provider: keyvaultco
    endpoint: https://api.keyvaultco.com
    auth: client_jwt
    pkcs11_lib: /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
    key_id: kvc-12345
```

ryan.platform: And a sample test curl to exercise envelope encryption in staging:

```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/kms/encrypt
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
 -d '{"key_id":"kvc-12345","plaintext":"hello"}'
```

Expected: 200 + ciphertext payload.

deploybot: Meeting scheduled: KeyVaultCo joint onboarding — Wed 10:00am PT. Calendar invites sent to channel.

alex.partnerships: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with partner for docs and creds, then update this thread with links. Thanks everyone — will loop back once I have their attestation + blurb.

joanne.pm: Adding to roadmap and will share draft announcement in #marketing once ready.
